title: When Will Apple's Macs Get M5 Chips? 2025-2026 Launch Timeline
text:
Apple’s M5 Chip Rollout: Mac ⁣Updates‌ Now Aiming for 2026, Alongside New iPad Pro and Vision⁢ Pro CUPERTINO, ​CA – November 4, ⁤2025 ​ – Apple’s transition to its next-generation M5 series chips is unfolding with a revised ‍timeline, pushing meaningful Mac updates – including ​a potential refresh of teh⁤ Mac Pro – ⁣into ‍2026. Initial expectations for an M4‌ Ultra⁤ chip powering a new Mac Pro have shifted, with Apple now appearing to focus on the ‍M5 architecture for considerable performance gains in its professional-grade machines.
The evolving⁢ chip strategy impacts⁢ a‌ wide range of Apple users, from creative professionals ⁤relying on ⁤Mac ‌Pro and Mac Studio performance to consumers anticipating upgrades to devices like the iPad ⁢Pro and Apple TV. The delay⁢ stems from challenges in developing an “Ultra” version of the M4 chip, as ‍the M4 Max architecture lacks the UltraFusion technology used ⁢in previous generations. ‍This has⁤ led Apple to consider either utilizing the M3‌ Ultra, already available in the Mac Studio, or waiting for the development ⁤of an M5 Ultra.
According to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, Apple initially planned to equip the Mac Pro with an M4⁤ Ultra featuring a 32-core CPU and 80-core GPU,‍ targeting a mid-to-late⁣ 2025 release. ​However,Gurman subsequently reported in March 2025 that development‍ of the M4 Ultra had been abandoned. With the M4 Max lacking UltraFusion capabilities, the possibility of an M4 Ultra chip‌ appears unlikely.
The current‌ expectation⁤ is that Apple will prioritize the M5 ⁤chip for significant updates. While the development of ⁣Ultra versions of Apple’s M-series chips typically requires more time, a mid-to-late 2026 timeframe is now considered ⁤more realistic​ for an M5 Ultra-powered Mac Pro.
Beyond the Mac‌ Pro, Apple is expected to unveil ⁤M5-powered devices in 2025, including a new iPad Pro and a refreshed Vision Pro. The company may‍ choose to announce these products through a dedicated ⁢event ⁢or via press releases. Other anticipated releases before the end of the year include a new ​HomePod mini, AirTag 2, and an updated apple TV.
